title: Trail-edge invasive removal in Metchosin

seo.title: Sample project: Metchosin invasive removal | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: English ivy and blackberry removed along a Metchosin trail edge outside nesting season, with work notes for the client.

summary: Ivy and blackberry removed along a public trail edge to a written plan.
scope: Ivy removal from trunks and ground
challenge: English ivy was climbing the trees along a trail edge, and Himalayan blackberry was narrowing the path.
approach: We timed the work outside the main nesting season, then cut ivy at the base of the trunks and pulled ground ivy and blackberry along the edge.
Invasive material went to an approved disposal site, and the client received work notes for its records.
result: A wider trail edge and trees free of ivy, documented for the client.
